entities.name: Ornithine carbamoyltransferase
observations: The 313-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein Q7NGR7 from Gloeobacter violaceus.
Curated function: reversibly transfers a carbamoyl group from carbamoyl phosphate to the Nε atom of L-ornithine, producing L-citrulline.
Reference annotation assigns EC 2.1.3.3 and cytoplasmic localization; Q7NGR7 is reported as a homohexamer.
Pfam domains OTCace_N (PF02729) and OTCace (PF00185) support the ornithine carbamoyltransferase family assignment.

entities.name: OTC carbamoylation reaction
observations: Carbamoyl phosphate + L-ornithine ⇌ L-citrulline + phosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19513 and EC 2.1.3.3.
This is the first committed step of the ornithine branch of L-arginine biosynthesis.

entities.name: Carbamoyl phosphate
observations: Donor substrate whose carbamoyl group is transferred by ornithine carbamoyltransferase.

entities.name: L-ornithine
observations: Acceptor substrate; carbamoylation occurs at its Nε atom to form L-citrulline.

entities.name: L-citrulline
observations: Product of carbamoyl transfer from carbamoyl phosphate to L-ornithine.
